#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a worst-case-size valid input."""
import json, random, sys

seed = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 7
npkt = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 20000
mode = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "full"
r = random.Random(seed)
C, E, K, F, W, S, L = 8, 4, 5, 8, 16, 256, 4
model = {
 "classes": C, "embedding_dim": E,
 "length_embedding": [[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
 "gap_embedding": [[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],
 "kernel": K,
 "conv_weights": [[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],
 "conv_bias": [r.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(F)],
 "conv_shift": [r.randint(0,16) for _ in range(F)],
 "dense_weights": [[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],
 "dense_bias": [r.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(C)],
}
nte = nce = 16
te = [0]
while len(te) < nte: te.append(te[-1] + r.randint(1, 1000))
ce = [0]
while len(ce) < nce: ce.append(ce[-1] + r.randint(1, 100))
prob = [[r.randint(0,65536) for _ in range(nce)] for _ in range(nte)]
cfg = {"slots": S, "window": W, "idle_timeout": 10**6, "len_quantum": 1,
       "gap_quantum": 1, "rate_num": 10**6, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 512,
       "initial_tokens": 512, "pending_capacity": 512, "lanes": L,
       "service": [1 for _ in range(C)], "fallback": 0, "time_edges": te,
       "count_edges": ce, "probability": prob}
nconn = 2048
ids = ["c%d" % i for i in range(nconn)]
conns = [{"id": ids[i], "slot": i % S, "label": i % C, "split": "dev" if i % 2 else "eval"}
         for i in range(nconn)]
pkts = []
t = 0
for i in range(npkt):
    t += 1
    pkts.append({"time": t, "connection": ids[i % nconn], "length": r.randint(0,65535),
                 "draw": r.randint(0, 30000)})
doc = {"version":1, "config":cfg, "model":model, "connections":conns, "packets":pkts}
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(doc))
PYEOF
